svg.title: SAS-UNet architecture
svg.desc: Five native-depth encoder stages, SliceAlign, physically stepped z scans, skip-connected decoder and training-only auxiliary heads.

g.aria-label: SliceSSMStudent · In-plane hierarchy with constant slice depth D
Skip features concatenate with upsampled decoder features
Down: strided conv (1,2,2). Up: transposed conv (1,2,2). D is never downsampled.
Encoder: two 1×3×3 convs per stage; E3 includes one extra 3×1×1 conv between them.
Decoder: 1×3×3 conv after each concat. Cubes show feature tensors; numbers are channels.
